subject: Request: Pilot window accommodation — connector stabilization delay
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir@novacore.ai>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@novacore.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot blocked by connector instability — asking for accommodation

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the onboarding call last week. We got the Redwood SDK wired into our staging environment and started the connector sync, but we’ve hit a persistent stability problem with the third-party data adapter (it crashes under sustained loads). Our engineers have spent 48 hours chasing memory spikes and inconsistent pagination behavior; I’ve attached the most recent logs and a short heap snapshot.

This issue has effectively blocked our planned demo next Tuesday and pushed the pilot timeline out by at least a couple weeks. Given the delay is on our side and we’re still excited about the product, I wanted to ask if Redwood can:

- Extend our pilot window by 30 days; and
- Apply a small trial credit allocation (~$2,000) to cover evaluation usage while our infra team stabilizes the connector.

We’re hopeful the adapter issue will be resolved within 7–10 business days, but we don’t want the pilot to auto-expire in the interim.

Appreciate any flexibility you can provide. Happy to jump on a short sync if that helps.

Best,
Samir Rao
CTO, NovaCore
(samir@novacore.ai)

Attachment: connector-error-log-20270617.txt (text)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@novacore.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@novacore.ai>, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot blocked by connector instability — asking for accommodation

Hi Samir —

Thanks for the detail and for sending the logs. Sorry to hear the adapter is giving you a hard time. I’ve skimmed the trace you attached and I agree it looks like a pagination/memory leak issue that will require a short fix and then a validation run.

I’m looping in Marissa (your AE) and Karthik from solutions to expedite an accommodation request. High level, here is what I’ll propose to the approvals team:

- 30-day pilot extension (no auto-expiry during the window)
- One-time trial credit allocation to cover additional tokens/embeddings during the validation period

Marissa/Karthik — can you weigh in on credit sizing and any approval steps? Samir, can you also confirm the expected remediation ETA once your infra patch is deployed? If it helps, we can do a short troubleshooting call Monday morning so our solutions engineer can watch a repro.

Sofia Ivanova
Head of Growth, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

--
Attachment: integration-snapshot-heap.png (image)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Samir Rao <samir@novacore.ai>, Priya Shah <priya@novacore.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot blocked by connector instability — asking for accommodation

Sofia / team —

Thanks for flagging. I reviewed the account and the pilot usage cadence; NovaCore is a solid-fit POC and we want to keep momentum. I’m approving the following on a one-time basis for deal NOV-4321:

- 30-day extension to the pilot window (effective immediately)
- $3,000 in trial credits applied to the account (to be used within the extended pilot window)

Condition: we’ll want a short validation call (30 minutes) with your infra engineer after the fix is deployed so Solutions can confirm the connector behaves under load. Please share a preferred time — I can make slots Monday morning PT.

Action items I’m capturing:
- Marissa: apply credits and extend pilot in the console (I’ll file the approval ticket) — DONE once this thread is acknowledged
- Karthik: stand by for the troubleshooting call and coordinate a quick validation checklist
- Samir: ping when the patch is deployed and share any updated logs or a repro link

Samir — I’ve created a HubSpot note and will attach the approval ticket. You should see the credits reflected in the portal within a business day.

Thanks — speak soon.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: novacore-pilot-plan-v2.docx (docx)
From: Samir Rao <samir@novacore.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@novacore.ai>, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot blocked by connector instability — asking for accommodation

Marissa / Sofia —

Really appreciate the quick turnaround and the credit allocation. We’ll take the $3k and the 30-day extension. Our infra lead pushed a patched adapter to staging this morning; attaching a short repro log and a screen capture from the staging run.

We’d like to schedule the validation call on Tuesday 06/22 at 10:30am PT if that works for Karthik and the solutions team. Priya and I will be on the line.

Thanks again for the flexibility — this keeps our demo timeline intact.

Best,
Samir Rao
CTO, NovaCore
